hero.headline: Automated testing, triggered by your stories
hero.subheadline: Testurio reads your user stories and runs AI-generated tests automatically — no test scripts to write.

features.title: Everything you need for automated testing

aiGeneration.title: AI Test Generation
aiGeneration.description: Claude generates test scenarios from your user stories automatically.

autoTrigger.title: Automatic Triggering
autoTrigger.description: Tests start the moment a story moves to your chosen status in ADO or Jira.

apiTesting.title: API Testing
apiTesting.description: Validates endpoints, status codes, and response shapes on every run.

uiE2e.title: UI End-to-End Testing
uiE2e.description: Playwright drives real browsers through your user flows automatically.

pmIntegration.title: PM Tool Integration
pmIntegration.description: Results are posted back as comments on the originating ADO or Jira ticket.

memoryLayer.title: Test Memory Layer
memoryLayer.description: Successful scenarios are stored and reused as examples in future generations.

connectPm.title: Connect your PM tool
connectPm.description: Link your Azure DevOps or Jira project with a single token — takes under two minutes.

moveStory.title: Move a story to "In Testing"
moveStory.description: Testurio listens for the status change and immediately queues a test run.

aiReads.title: AI reads the story and generates scenarios
aiReads.description: Claude analyses the acceptance criteria and produces typed test scenarios.

testsRun.title: Tests run automatically
testsRun.description: API and UI end-to-end tests execute against your staging environment in parallel.

resultsPosted.title: Results posted back to your ticket
resultsPosted.description: A structured verdict with pass/fail details appears as a comment on the story.

pricingTeaser.title: Simple, transparent pricing
pricingTeaser.summary: Simple, transparent pricing. Start free, scale as you grow.
